reviews.title: Why do I need to invite another user?
reviews.text: Hello, I am writing this review in regards to my recent frustration when trying to set up a WeChat account for myself. When setting up a WeChat account, you do everything quite normal like any other messaging app, but in order to create the account you must have someone else register on WeChat as well with a QR code. I am frustrated with this process because it feels the app is trying to mandatorily force users to reach out to others and use WeChat as well. Overall, wanting to advertise your app is completely fine, but it can definitely feel a little overwhelming or unsettling, for users trying to set up an account. Which I believe, would lead to a decrease in new users because of that.
